items.name: Government-issued photo ID
items.where_to_find: Driver's license or passport; front and back.

items.name: 2 most recent months of bank statements (all pages)
items.why: Shows funds for down payment, closing costs, and reserves.
items.where_to_find: Bank website or app under Statements; download PDF including blank pages.

items.name: Homeowners insurance agent contact
items.why: Your lender needs insurance in place before closing.
items.where_to_find: Name and phone of your agent is enough to start.
